description: Take-home pay for an employee in Germany from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 tariff, splitting for married couples; Soli and church tax (8% BY/BW, 9% elsewhere); Social insurance up to the 2026 ceilings, own Zusatzbeitrag, Saxony care rate; Kindergeld vs Kinderfreibetrag (Günstigerprüfung), childless care surcharge and child reductions; Single-parent relief (class II); Deferred compensation into a company pension (bAV).

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

church.description: Church tax. Only members of a registered church pay it.: none = No church tax; 9 = 9% (most states); 8 = 8% (Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg). Default none.

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in EUR, without bonus

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

saxony.description: Work in Saxony. In Saxony employees pay 0.5% more long-term care insurance. Default false.

single_parent.description: Single parent (tax class II). Entlastungsbetrag €4,260 + €240 per extra child, with children living with you. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final), 2024 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

zusatz.description: Health insurer Zusatzbeitrag. The extra contribution of your Krankenkasse; 2.9% is the 2026 average. Employer pays half. (%). Default 2.9.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Germany (2026)
